headline: A 2019 law renamed the Large Synoptic Survey Telescope the Vera C. Rubin Observatory.
what_it_does: This law gives the Large Synoptic Survey Telescope a new official name, the Vera C. Rubin Observatory. It honors astronomer Vera C. Rubin, known for her work on galaxy rotation. The law is a designation only and does not appropriate money or create new rules.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was signed into law on December 20, 2019.
